name: hq-marketing
description: Scopes "type": "module" to this directory ONLY — same trick and same reason as sync-rxdb/package.json: the repo root package.json carries no "type" field, so Node parses every .js under it as CommonJS and a plain `import` of these files throws SyntaxError. Declares NO dependencies and NO scripts: the root has no `workspaces` key so `npm ci` never sees it, browsers ignore it entirely, and the RxDB/supabase-js engine reaches the browser through the committed vendor/rxdb.bundle.js — not through npm.
